name: A Visit to Gregan
label: Quest
description: A Visit to Gregan: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm not quite sure what to make of this, friend. The plants... They seem to have some minimal intelligence.
I'm no expert, though. But, I do know someone that is!
Head to northern Feralas, and look for a buddy of mine named Gregan Brewspewer. He's an expert on this sort of thing.
I'm sure Gregan can help us out here. You'll find him out in the wilderness; he's not the type to live in a big city.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I live out here in the forest... Peaceful.
Well, at least I thought it would be. I get more visitors out here than I ever did when I lived in Ironforge!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Bloodpetal, eh? Hmmm... Well, you better explain the plan, and then I'll tell you whether or not I can help you.
